title: The Ictyron
description: This mod ads a new golem and an OP sword
body:
This mod adds a new golem called Abdib and an extremely overpowered sword named Pesce Spada.

The mod is intentionally pointless and exists purely for fun and experimentation. It does not aim to add balance, progression, or serious gameplay mechanics. It simply adds a strong entity and a ridiculous weapon for players who enjoy absurd and unconventional content.

This project is meant to be lighthearted and entertaining rather than useful or realistic.

 

**REQUIREMENTS:**

**GekoLib 1.20.1**

**Just Enough Items (Optional)**





**_If you like it or not, please let me know in the comments (or on Github) what I should modify or add!_**
